children: RNS Number : 8609T  Christie Group PLC  08 September 2026
Christie & Co publishes Dental Market Review 2026
Annual review highlights improving investor appetite, greater lender confidence and increasing activity among corporate operators

Christie Group plc (CTG.L) reports that its agency and advisory business, Christie & Co, has published its Dental Market Review 2026. The report provides a comprehensive overview of the UK Dental market, combining insights from Christie & Co's own transactional activity, buyer and seller sentiment surveys, and thousands of valuation, consultancy and brokerage projects that are delivered each year. The report also features commentary from both Christie Finance and Christie Insurance, two of the Group's additional advisory businesses, on the latest lending and insurance market dynamics impacting the sector.

The report highlights a market that remains active and resilient, with strong demand driving positive pricing outcomes for vendors. Independent providers continued to dominate transactional activity over the period of review, accounting for more than 75% of Christie & Co's transactions in a market which continues to be characterised by its fragmented ownership structure. Notwithstanding this, buyer demand has continued to strengthen throughout 2026, particularly among corporate operators and larger dental groups which account for half of offers so far this year.
Looking ahead, the review suggests that the overall UK dental market value is forecast to grow further, reaching approximately £15 billion by 2027/28.

Christie & Co's Dental team is widely recognised as one of the UK's leading advisers, providing a range of services from brokerage to valuation and consultancy across the sector. Christie Finance, Christie Insurance and Pinders offer complementary services. Christie & Co also recently announced the launch of its advisory and brokerage services in the Republic of Ireland dental market, to support the growing investor and operator interest in this region too.

Dan Prickett, Chief Executive of Christie Group plc, comments: ""The dental market has continued to strengthen through 2026, with returning levels of activity from corporate operators, larger dental groups and private equity houses following a recalibration of the dental market in recent years. Across our Professional & Financial Services businesses, our specialist teams are well placed to support owners, operators, investors and lenders as they navigate this market, reinforcing Christie Group's market-leading advisory position in this essential sector."

Christie Group plc, quoted on AIM, is a leading professional business services group with 32 offices across the UK and Europe, catering to its specialist markets in the healthcare, hospitality, leisure, medical, childcare & education and retail sectors.

Christie Group operates in two complementary business divisions: Professional & Financial Services (PFS) and Stock & Inventory Systems & Services (SISS). These divisions trade under the brand names: PFS - Christie & Co, Pinders, Christie Finance and Christie Insurance: SISS - Venners.

Tracing its origins back to 1896, the Group has a long-established reputation for offering valued services to client companies in agency, valuation services, investment, consultancy, project management, stock audit and inventory management. The diversity of these services provides a natural balance to the Group's core agency business.

Republic of Ireland services are provided by CHRISTIE OWEN & DAVIES (IRELAND) LIMITED (a company incorporated in the Republic of Ireland, CRN 814356), and licensed by the Property Services Regulatory Authority. (Licence No. 004939).
